ModMetaData.name: TorchesOut
ModMetaData.author: hyperchomp
ModMetaData.description: Sick of torches burning with no colonists around and using up all your wood? Well, now they don't. Features • The last colonist out of a room puts out its torches, and the next one in lights them back up. • Prisoners, and patients in medical beds, are never left in the dark. • Outdoor torches go out during the day. • At night, outdoor torches light up as soon as someone comes into their light radius, so they don't waste fuel when no one's around. • Mark any torch "Always on" to keep it lit no matter what. • Torches you switch off yourself stay off. Mod Options • Relight torches when a colonist walks into a dark room. • Only put torches out once a room is completely empty. • Only keep outdoor torches lit near colonists. • Turn off outdoor torches during the day. • Update interval: how long a room stays empty before its torches go out, and how often outdoor torches check for daylight and nearby people. Save Compatibility Safe to add to or remove from an existing save. Performance Built with performance in mind: torches only react when someone changes rooms, and outdoor torches check for daylight and nearby people every 30 ticks (configurable in the mod options). Bugs / Feedback Please report bugs, compatibility issues and suggestions in the Workshop discussions.
